$schema_comment: Capability catalog for the orchestrator runtime. References domains from orchestrator/agents/capability-matrix.v1.json — does NOT redefine them. Aligned with docs/orchestrator/runtime-permission-contract.md §3.

doc_categories.description: Allowed documentation retrieval scopes per context_retrieval domain.

capability_classes.description: Fine-grained action classes within each domain. Evaluator uses these to resolve action_class from raw tool input.

write_local_repo.description: Write to files within the current workspace/repo root.

write_draft.description: Write to a scratch or draft location outside the repo (e.g. /tmp, notes).

write_external_state.description: Write that mutates external or shared state (database, remote config, deployed artifact).

external_side_effect.description: Action with observable external side effect beyond the local workspace.

ambiguous_write.description: Write whose target class cannot be determined from input alone. Must not proceed without classification.

destructive.description: Irreversible deletion or overwrite of existing state.

trust_levels.local_declared: MCP server configured locally AND declared in project policy or built-in profile.
trust_levels.remote_declared: Remote MCP endpoint declared explicitly with target class and allowed capabilities.
trust_levels.runtime_discovered: MCP/tool seen during execution but NOT in any declaration source.

scoped_retrieval.description: Retrieval bounded by declared scopes, chunk budget, no full-file access.

full_file_retrieval.description: Attempt to retrieve a full file as a document. Forbidden by default in all profiles.

credential_classes.description: Credential-related action classes. Always deny reveal/export regardless of profile.

credential_reveal.description: Printing, echoing, or displaying a secret value in any output.

credential_export.description: Writing a secret value to a file, log, or external target.
